name: dblens
description: Inspect and diagnose PostgreSQL and SQL Server databases from Claude. Read-only; returns no row data by default.
long_description: Schema overview, undeclared foreign keys (from naming, views, routines and query history), index health, fragmentation, GDPR exposure, cascade paths, migration safety, query plans and a generated data map. Connect it with a read-only database login: dblens refuses to execute caller SQL on a login that can write.

sqlserver_connection.title: SQL Server connection string
sqlserver_connection.description: For a read-only login, e.g. Server=localhost;Database=erp;User Id=dblens_reader;Password=…;TrustServerCertificate=true
